question_text: A 4-year-old girl is brought to the physician because of increasing swelling around her eyes and over both her feet for the past 4 days. During this period, she has had frothy light yellow urine. Her vital signs are within normal limits. Physical examination shows periorbital edema and 2+ pitting edema of the lower legs and ankles. A urinalysis of this patient is most likely to show which of the following findings?
